implementation_summary: Removed the bespoke frontend interactive protocol now fully superseded by A2UI (src/a2ui/*). Deleted the whole src/components/InteractiveElements/ tree (InteractiveSurface, registry, utils, elementHandlers/*, its two test files), src/types/entity/interactive.ts (9 element types + InteractiveRequest/InteractiveResponse/InteractiveFeaturesConfig), the dead src/utils/interactive.ts (isInteractiveRequestAnswered), ChatAiInteractiveBlock.tsx with its test, and src/store/__tests__/chatGeneration.interactive.test.ts. InteractiveErrorBoundary was still consumed by the new ChatA2uiBlock, so it was moved into the A2UI module as src/a2ui/A2uiErrorBoundary.tsx (class renamed, console tag '[A2UI]', data-testid interactive-surface-error -> a2ui-surface-error; nothing referenced the old testid) and ChatA2uiBlock now imports it from there. Legacy protocol fields stripped: ChatMessage.interactiveRequest/interactiveResponse and HistoryItemBackend.interactiveRequest/interactiveResponse and StreamChunk.interactive_request in src/types/entity/conversation.ts, ChatRequest.interactiveResponse and ChatGenerationOptions.interactiveResponse in src/types/chatGeneration.ts, their mapping in src/utils/chatHelpers.ts, and in src/store/chatGeneration.ts the store-type member + method submitInteractiveResponse, the interactiveResponse plumbing in createChatGeneration (destructuring, request body, optimistic history item) and the chunk.interactive_request branch of _handleChunk; _handleRequestError now rolls back on historyItem.a2uiAction alone while the shared _removeOptimisticTurn helper (used by the A2UI path) is kept. ChatAiMessage.tsx renders ChatA2uiBlock unconditionally (legacy fallback branch and its import gone) and the edit-unlock guard keys on a2uiEnvelopes only; ChatUserMessage.tsx drops the interactive-response-chip branch, leaving the a2ui chip and the plain-text body. Assistant side: the @deprecated interactive_features field and its import removed from src/types/entity/assistant.ts, stale comment in src/store/utils/assistants.ts reworded (InteractiveFeaturesSection/Accordion and the features:interactiveElements flag are the T-X1-FE boolean surface and were left untouched). Test cleanup: ChatUserMessageChip.test.tsx keeps only the a2ui chip cases, ChatAiMessage.test.tsx loses the InteractiveRequest import, the submitInteractiveResponse vi.mock entry and the legacy checkbox-surface case, store/utils assistants.test.ts drops the deprecated-per-group-config case (the field no longer exists; InteractiveFeaturesSection.integration.test.tsx still asserts the request body has no interactive_features), and ChatA2uiBlock.test.tsx loses its submitInteractiveResponse mock. Non-legacy coverage that only lived in the deleted store test was preserved by porting an equivalent 'processing duration for a surface-only response with no assistant text' case into ChatA2uiBlock.test.tsx.
passing_command: npm run typecheck && npx vitest run --project unit && npx vitest run --project integration
passing_excerpt: tsc --noEmit: clean (no output). Unit: Test Files 368 passed (368), Tests 4244 passed (4244) — baseline before removal was 372 files / 4284 tests, i.e. exactly the 4 deleted legacy test files (InteractiveSurface, InteractiveElements registry, ChatAiInteractiveBlock, chatGeneration.interactive) and 40 legacy cases, zero failures. Integration: Test Files 35 passed (35), Tests 464 passed | 1 skipped (465) — identical to baseline.
